snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that fresh live engineering sessions finally exercised the department/worker architecture deeply enough to expose real routing, grant, and completion-evidence defects, and those defects were repaired on main. This materially increases confidence in autonomous operations, while business proof remains constrained because the public site still reports no paying customers.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation state, recent merged fixes from live autonomous sessions, Gatekeeper-reviewed site work, the live commercial offer and checkout surface, venture activity, and explicit public customer/revenue evidence. snapshots.changed: The biggest change is operational simplification: Gatekeeper was reduced from a costly, churn-prone AI copy critic to a deterministic publish-safety/CI gate with retryable HOLD semantics, while live-run defects around Bash mutation, false-failure permits, worker completion truth, and blocker delivery were repaired. This raises technical and autonomy confidence, but the Day-90 revenue range is more conservative because there is still no paying-customer evidence or proven acquisition channel despite new SEO/resource pages.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in current main-branch implementation state, recent autonomous-run defect repairs, the simplified publish-safety gate, current fulfillment/billing capability truth, live site/offer evidence, active venture updates, and explicit customer/revenue evidence. snapshots.changed: The biggest change is that the venture lab gained a real evidence-and-economics layer: attributed revenue/direct cost, measured behavior and retention, pre-declared success criteria, and fail-closed advancement gates now exist on main. Routing, branch delivery, and stale self-exec authority defects were also repaired, and new resource pages shipped. This raises technical, autonomy, and commercial confidence, but business proof moves only slightly because Stromation still publicly reports no customers and there is still no proven repeatable acquisition channel or verified venture revenue/PMF.
snapshots.method: Independent estimate grounded in the current main-branch implementation, recent autonomous-run and authority/delivery defect repairs, new venture economics/behavior/experiment infrastructure, fresh site/resource and scheduled venture updates, the live commercial offer, and explicit public customer/revenue evidence.
